From 91edf63d5022bd0464788ffb4acc3d5febbaf81d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Bryan O'Donoghue <bryan.odonoghue@linaro.org>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2020 08:49:18 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] usb: chipidea: msm: Ensure proper controller reset using role
 switch API

Currently we check to make sure there is no error state on the extcon
handle for VBUS when writing to the HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2 register. When using
the USB role-switch API we still need to write to this register absent an
extcon handle.

This patch makes the appropriate update to ensure the write happens if
role-switching is true.

Fixes: 05559f10ed79 ("usb: chipidea: add role switch class support")
Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Cc: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>
Cc: Philipp Zabel <p.zabel@pengutronix.de>
Cc: linux-usb@vger.kernel.org
Cc: linux-kernel@vger.kernel.org
Cc: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org>
Signed-off-by: Bryan O'Donoghue <bryan.odonoghue@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Peter Chen <peter.chen@nxp.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200507004918.25975-2-peter.chen@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c b/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c
index af648ba6544d..46105457e1ca 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c
@@ -114,7 +114,7 @@ static int ci_hdrc_msm_notify_event(struct ci_hdrc *ci, unsigned event)
 			hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
 					HS_PHY_ULPI_TX_PKT_EN_CLR_FIX, 0);
 
-		if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev)) {
+		if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev) || ci->role_switch) {
 			hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
 					HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN,
 					HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/usb/chipidea/ci_hdrc_msm.c`**
   - The conditional check for writing to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register has been modified. 
   - The original condition checked if the `vbus_extcon.edev` was not an error (`!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev)`).
   - The updated condition now also includes a check for `ci->role_switch`, allowing the write to occur even if there is no extcon handle, provided that role-switching is enabled.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in the `ci_hdrc_msm.c` file addresses a specific bug related to the USB role-switch API. By allowing the write to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register when role-switching is true, the patch ensures that the controller reset is handled correctly, regardless of the state of the external connector (extcon) for VBUS. This change is crucial for maintaining proper functionality when the USB role-switching feature is utilized, thereby fixing the issue introduced in a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag).

You will be given details about a bug, including:
1. The root cause.

Be conservative in your assessment. If you are unsure, answer "no."

Root cause:
The bug arises from the failure to write to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register when using the USB role-switch API, specifically when there is no valid external connector (extcon) handle for VBUS. The original code only allowed the write operation if the extcon handle was valid, which could lead to improper controller reset behavior during role-switching scenarios.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev)) {
    hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN);
}
```
Reason:
The original code only allows writing to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register if there is a valid external connector (extcon) handle for VBUS. This means that if the extcon handle is invalid (i.e., there is no valid connection), the write operation is skipped, which can lead to improper controller reset behavior during role-switching scenarios.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (!IS_ERR(ci->platdata->vbus_extcon.edev) || ci->role_switch) {
    hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN,
                    HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN);
}
```
Reason:
The patch modifies the condition to include a check for `ci->role_switch`. This ensures that the write to the `HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2` register occurs even when there is no valid extcon handle, as long as role-switching is enabled. This change guarantees that the controller reset behavior is properly handled during role-switching scenarios.

			hw_write_id_reg(ci, HS_PHY_GENCONFIG_2,

					HS_PHY_SESS_VLD_CTRL_EN);
